metaDescription: Techlio is an AI-ready engineering firm with offices in the USA and Pakistan, partnering with startups and enterprises to design, build, secure and scale AI-driven products.
heroTitle: An engineering firm first. *AI is what we build with it.*
heroIntro: Techlio partners with startups and enterprises to design, build, secure and scale AI-driven digital products. We are engineers who learned AI by shipping it into real systems.

purpose.title: Mission
purpose.text: Deliver AI-led innovation and full-cycle engineering that solves real problems for our clients and keeps paying off after launch.

purpose.title: Vision
purpose.text: To be the AI and engineering partner that teams trust with their hardest ideas, and the one they call for the next.

values.title: Transparency
values.text: You hear about a slipped estimate or a failed approach from us, the day we know.

values.title: Quality as the standard
values.text: Tests, evals, security checks and senior review are part of the work, not an optional extra on the invoice.

values.title: Client first
values.text: Decisions are made for the product and the client, including when that means recommending less work.

values.title: Partnership over transactions
values.text: Several of our clients have worked with us for seven years or more. We plan for the long run, not the first invoice.

values.title: Problem solving
values.text: Hard constraints are the interesting part. We would rather be handed the difficult module.

values.title: Adaptive workflow
values.text: We fit your tools, time zone and release rhythm instead of asking you to adopt ours.

closeTitle: Meet the engineers who would do the work
closeText: The scoping call is with a senior engineer who stays on your project.
